title: Anti-Fragility
hook: That brutal month you just had is only wasted if nothing changes after it.
statement: Some systems get stronger under stress, but only if you actually change something after the hit.
explainer: Bouncing back isn't the same as getting better. If you recover and run the exact same playbook, the next setback lands just as hard.
sop: For each, note whether you changed the system or just recovered.
Score Stress and Adaptation from 1 to 10.
Pick one hard thing to take on on purpose this month.
Afterward, write what you'll change in the system, not just the lesson.
equation_example: Stress 7, Adaptation 8. 7 × 8 = 56. Higher means the hit actually made you stronger. Lower means you took the punch and nothing improved.
question: Name one challenge you've been dodging that would make you tougher if you faced it.
closing_statement: Let the hard stuff upgrade you, not just pass through.
caption:
Principle Nº 185: Anti-Fragility

That brutal month you just had is only wasted if nothing changes after it.

Some systems get stronger under stress, but only if you actually change something after the hit.

Your turn: Name one challenge you've been dodging that would make you tougher if you faced it.
